060  public static class UnsupportedCompressionType extends RuntimeException {
061
062    public UnsupportedCompressionType() {}
063
064    public UnsupportedCompressionType(String message) {
065      super(message);
066    }
067
068    public UnsupportedCompressionType(String message, Throwable cause) {
069      super(message, cause);
070    }
071  }
072
073  private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CompressionUtil.class);
074  private static final int BUFFER = 2048;
075  private static final String APPLE_RESOURCE_FORK = "__MACOSX";
076  private static final byte[] TAR_MAGIC_BYTES = new byte[] {'u', 's', 't', 'a', 'r'};
077
078  /**
079   * Tries to decompress a file into a newly created temporary directory, trying gzip or zip regardless of the filename
080   * or its suffix.
081   *
082   * @return folder containing all decompressed files
083   */
084  public static File decompressFile(File compressedFile)
085      throws IOException, UnsupportedCompressionType {
086    // create empty tmp dir
087    File dir = File.createTempFile("gbif-", null);
088    if (dir.exists() && !dir.delete()) {
089      throw new IOException("Couldn't delete temporary directory");
090    }
091
092    if (!dir.mkdirs()) {
093      throw new IOException("Couldn't create temporary directory for decompression");
094    }
095
096    // decompress
097    decompressFile(dir, compressedFile);
098
099    return dir;
100  }

134  /**
135   * Tries to decompress a file using TAR+gzip, gzip, TAR or Zip regardless of the filename or its suffix.
136   *
137   * @param directory      directory where archive's contents will be decompressed to
138   * @param compressedFile compressed file
139   * @param unzippedFileName unzipped file name (in case of one file)
140   *
141   * @return list of files that have been extracted or null an empty list if archive couldn't be decompressed
142   *
143   * @throws IOException                if problem occurred reading compressed file, or directory couldn't be written
144   *                                    to
145   * @throws UnsupportedCompressionType if the compression type wasn't recognized
146   */
147  public static List<File> decompressFile(
148      File directory, File compressedFile, String unzippedFileName, boolean keepSubdirectories)
149      throws IOException, UnsupportedCompressionType {
150    List<File> files = null;
151
152    // Test before trying Zstandard format
153    if (isZstdFormat(compressedFile)) {
154      try {
155        LOG.debug("Uncompressing {} with Zstd compression to {}", compressedFile, directory);
156        files = untzstdFile(directory, compressedFile);
157      } catch (Exception e) {
158        LOG.error("Not TAR Zstd compression");
159      }
160    }
161
162    // Test before trying gzip format
163    if (isGzipFormat(compressedFile)) {
164      try {
165        LOG.debug("Uncompressing {} with gzip compression to {}", compressedFile, directory);
166        files = untgzFile(directory, compressedFile);
167      } catch (IOException e) {
168        LOG.debug("Not .tar.gz compression, trying .gz");
169        files = ungzipFile(directory, compressedFile, unzippedFileName, false);
170      } catch (Exception e) {
171        LOG.error("Not gzip compression");
172      }
173    }
174
175    // Test before trying TAR format
176    if (isTarFormat(compressedFile)) {
177      try {
178        LOG.debug("Uncompressing {} with TAR compression to {}", compressedFile, directory);
179        files = untarFile(directory, compressedFile);
180      } catch (Exception e) {
181        LOG.debug("Not TAR compression");
182      }
183    }
184
185    // Then try zip
186    if (files == null) {
187      try {
188        LOG.debug("Uncompressing {} with Zip compression to {}", compressedFile, directory);
189        files = unzipFile(directory, compressedFile, keepSubdirectories);
190      } catch (ZipException e) {
191        LOG.debug("Not Zip compression");
192        throw new UnsupportedCompressionType("Unknown compression type. Neither gzip nor Zip", e);
193      }
194    }
195
196    if (files.isEmpty()) {
197      LOG.warn("No files extracted from {}, tried TGZ, TAR and Zip compression.", compressedFile);
198    }
199
200    return files;
201  }
202
203  /**
204   * Check the file's first four bytes, to see if they are the Zstandard magic number.
205   * @param compressedFile compressed file
206   * @return               true if the file is in Zstd format
207   * @throws IOException   if a problem occurred reading compressed file
208   */
209  public static boolean isZstdFormat(File compressedFile) throws IOException {
210    try (RandomAccessFile file = new RandomAccessFile(compressedFile, "r")) {
211      byte[] header =  new byte[4];
212      file.read(header);
213      return ZstdUtils.matches(header, 4);
214    }
215  }
216
217  /**
218   * Check the file's first two bytes, to see if they are the gzip magic number.
219   * @param compressedFile compressed file
220   * @return               true if the file is in gzip format
221   * @throws IOException   if a problem occurred reading compressed file
222   */
223  public static boolean isGzipFormat(File compressedFile) throws IOException {
224    try (RandomAccessFile file = new RandomAccessFile(compressedFile, "r")) {
225      return GZIPInputStream.GZIP_MAGIC == (file.read() & 0xff | ((file.read() << 8) & 0xff00));
226    }
227  }
228
229  /**
230   * Check the file is a Tape ARchive (TAR).
231   * @param compressedFile compressed file
232   * @return               true if the file is a TAR
233   * @throws IOException   if a problem occurred reading compressed file
234   */
235  public static boolean isTarFormat(File compressedFile) throws IOException {
236    try (RandomAccessFile file = new RandomAccessFile(compressedFile, "r")) {
237      // TAR files contain "ustar\0" or "ustar " at byte 257.
238      // https://www.gnu.org/software/tar/manual/html_node/Standard.html
239      byte[] at257 = new byte[5];
240      file.seek(257);
241      file.read(at257, 0, 5);
242      return Arrays.equals(at257, TAR_MAGIC_BYTES);
243    } catch (Exception e) {
244      LOG.debug("Exc", e);
245    }
246    return false;
247  }

249  /**
250   * Extracts a Zstandard TAR file. Directory structure and hidden files (i.e. files starting with a dot) are ignored.
251   *
252   * @param directory where the file should be extracted to
253   * @param tarzstFile   to extract
254   *
255   * @return a list of all created files
256   */
257  public static List<File> untzstdFile(File directory, File tarzstFile) throws IOException {
258    return untarStream(directory, new ZstdCompressorInputStream(Files.newInputStream(tarzstFile.toPath())));
259  }

261  /**

263   *
264   * @param directory where the file should be extracted to
265   * @param tgzFile   to extract
266   *
267   * @return a list of all created files

269  public static List<File> untgzFile(File directory, File tgzFile) throws IOException {
270    return untarStream(directory, new GZIPInputStream(Files.newInputStream(tgzFile.toPath())));

273  /**
274   * Extracts a plain TAR file. Directory structure and hidden files (i.e. files starting with a dot) are ignored.
275   *
276   * @param directory where the file should be extracted to
277   * @param tarFile   to extract
278   *
279   * @return a list of all created files
280   */
281  public static List<File> untarFile(File directory, File tarFile) throws IOException {
282    return untarStream(directory, Files.newInputStream(tarFile.toPath()));
283  }
284
285  /**
286   * Extracts a TAR stream. Directory structure and hidden files (i.e. files starting with a dot) are ignored.
287   *
288   * @param directory where the file should be extracted to
289   * @param tarStream to extract
290   *
291   * @return a list of all created files
292   */
293  private static List<File> untarStream(File directory, InputStream tarStream) throws IOException {
294    List<File> files = new ArrayList<>();
295    try (TarArchiveInputStream in = new TarArchiveInputStream(tarStream)) {
296      TarArchiveEntry entry;
297      while ((entry = in.getNextTarEntry()) != null) {
298        if (entry.isDirectory()) {
299          LOG.debug("TAR archive contains directories which are being ignored");
300          continue;
301        }
302        String fn = new File(entry.getName()).getName();
303        if (fn.startsWith(".")) {
304          LOG.debug("TAR archive contains a hidden file {} which is being ignored", fn);
305          continue;
306        }
307        File targetFile = new File(directory, fn);
308        if (targetFile.exists()) {
309          LOG.warn("TAR archive contains duplicate filename {}, only the first was extracted", fn);
310          continue;
311        }
312        LOG.debug("Extracting file: {} to: {}", entry.getName(), targetFile.getAbsolutePath());
313        try (FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(targetFile)) {
314          IOUtils.copy(in, out);
315        }
316        files.add(targetFile);
317      }
318    }
319    return files;
320  }

322  /**
323   * Gunzip a file.  Use this method with isTarred false if the gzip contains a single file.  If it's a gzip
324   * of a TAR pass true to isTarred (or call {@link org.gbif.utils.file.CompressionUtil#untgzFile(File, File)}
325   * which is what this method just redirects to for isTarred).
326   *
327   * @param directory the output directory for the uncompressed file(s)
328   * @param gzipFile  the gzip file
329   * @param isTarred  true if the gzip contains a TAR
330   *
331   * @return a List of the uncompressed file name(s)
332   *
333   * @throws IOException if reading or writing fails
334   */
335  public static List<File> ungzipFile(File directory, File gzipFile, boolean isTarred)
336      throws IOException {
337    if (isTarred) return untgzFile(directory, gzipFile);
338
339    String unzippedName = gzipFile.getName().substring(0, gzipFile.getName().lastIndexOf("."));
340    return ungzipFile(directory, gzipFile, unzippedName, isTarred);
341  }
342
343  /**
344   * Gunzip a file.  Similar to {@link org.gbif.utils.file.CompressionUtil#ungzipFile(File, File, boolean)},
345   * but with ability to control unzipped file name.
346   *
347   * @param directory the output directory for the uncompressed file(s)
348   * @param gzipFile  the gzip file
349   * @param unzippedName  the unzipped file
350   * @param isTarred  true if the gzip contains a TAR
351   *
352   * @return a List of the uncompressed file name(s)
353   *
354   * @throws IOException if reading or writing fails
355   */
356  public static List<File> ungzipFile(
357      File directory, File gzipFile, String unzippedName, boolean isTarred) throws IOException {
358    if (isTarred) return untgzFile(directory, gzipFile);
359
360    List<File> files = new ArrayList<>();
361    BufferedOutputStream dest = null;
362    try (GZIPInputStream in = new GZIPInputStream(Files.newInputStream(gzipFile.toPath()))) {
363
364      // assume that the gzip filename is the filename + .gz
365      String unzippedNameResult;
366      if (StringUtils.isEmpty(unzippedName)) {
367        unzippedNameResult = gzipFile.getName().substring(0, gzipFile.getName().lastIndexOf("."));
368      } else {
369        unzippedNameResult = unzippedName;
370      }
371
372      File outputFile = new File(directory, unzippedNameResult);
373      LOG.debug("Extracting file: {} to: {}", unzippedNameResult, outputFile.getAbsolutePath());
374      FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(outputFile);
375
376      dest = new BufferedOutputStream(fos, BUFFER);
377      int count;
378      byte[] data = new byte[BUFFER];
379      while ((count = in.read(data, 0, BUFFER)) != -1) {
380        dest.write(data, 0, count);
381      }
382      files.add(outputFile);
383    } finally {
384      if (dest != null) {
385        dest.flush();
386        dest.close();
387      }
388    }
389
390    return files;
391  }

402  /**
403   * Zip a directory with all files but skipping included subdirectories.
404   * Only files directly within the directory are added to the archive.
405   *
406   * @param dir     the directory to zip
407   * @param zipFile the zipped file
408   */
409  public static void zipDir(File dir, File zipFile) throws IOException {
410    zipDir(dir, zipFile, false);
411  }
412
413  /**
414   * Zip a directory with all files. Files in Subdirectories will be included if the inclSubdirs is true.
415   *
416   * @param dir     the directory to zip
417   * @param zipFile the zipped file
418   * @param inclSubdirs if true includes all subdirectories recursively
419   */
420  public static void zipDir(File dir, File zipFile, boolean inclSubdirs) throws IOException {
421    Collection<File> files = org.apache.commons.io.FileUtils.listFiles(dir, null, inclSubdirs);
422    zipFiles(files, dir, zipFile);
423  }
424
425  public static void zipFile(File file, File zipFile) throws IOException {
426    Set<File> files = new HashSet<>();
427    files.add(file);
428    zipFiles(files, file.getParentFile(), zipFile);
429  }
430
431  /**
432   * Creates a zip archive from a given collection of files.
433   * In order to preserve paths in the archive a rootContext can be specified which will be removed from the individual
434   * zip entries. For example a rootContext of /home/freak with a file /home/freak/photo/birthday.jpg to be zipped
435   * will result in a zip entry with a path photo/birthday.jpg.
436   *
437   * @param files to be included in the zip archive
438   * @param rootContext optional path to be removed from each file
439   * @param zipFile the zip file to be created
440   * @throws IOException
441   */
442  public static void zipFiles(Collection<File> files, File rootContext, File zipFile)
443      throws IOException {
444    if (files.isEmpty()) {
445      LOG.info("no files to zip.");
446    } else {
447      try {
448        BufferedInputStream origin = null;
449        FileOutputStream dest = new FileOutputStream(zipFile);
450        ZipOutputStream out = new ZipOutputStream(new BufferedOutputStream(dest));
451        // out.setMethod(ZipOutputStream.DEFLATED);
452        byte[] data = new byte[BUFFER];
453        for (File f : files) {
454          LOG.debug("Adding file {} to archive", f);
455          FileInputStream fi = new FileInputStream(f);
456          origin = new BufferedInputStream(fi, BUFFER);
457
458          String zipPath =
459              StringUtils.removeStart(
460                  f.getAbsolutePath(), rootContext.getAbsolutePath() + File.separator);
461          ZipEntry entry = new ZipEntry(zipPath);
462          out.putNextEntry(entry);
463          int count;
464          while ((count = origin.read(data, 0, BUFFER)) != -1) {
465            out.write(data, 0, count);
466          }
467          origin.close();
468        }
469        out.finish();
470        out.close();
471      } catch (IOException e) {
472        LOG.error("IOException while zipping files: {}", files);
473        throw e;
474      }
475    }
476  }

478  /**
479   * Extracts a zipped file into a target directory. If the file is wrapped in a root directory, this is removed by
480   * default. Other subdirectories are ignored according to the parameter keepSubdirectories.
481   * </br>
482   * The following types of files are also ignored by default:
483   * i) hidden files (i.e. files starting with a dot)
484   * ii) Apple resource fork (__MACOSX), including its subdirectories and subfiles
485   *
486   * @param directory          where the zipped file and its subdirectories should be extracted to
487   * @param zipFile            to extract
488   * @param keepSubdirectories whether to preserve subdirectories or not
489   *
490   * @return a list of all created files and directories extracted to target directory
491   */
492  public static List<File> unzipFile(File directory, File zipFile, boolean keepSubdirectories)
493      throws IOException {
494    LOG.debug(
495        "Unzipping archive "
496            + zipFile.getName()
497            + " into directory: "
498            + directory.getAbsolutePath());
499
500    // This is changed from using ZipFile to a ZipInputStream since Java 8u192 can't open certain
501    // Zip64 files.
502    // https://bugs.openjdk.java.net/browse/JDK-8186464
503    try (FileInputStream fInput = new FileInputStream(zipFile);
504        ZipInputStream zipInput = new ZipInputStream(fInput)) {
505      ZipEntry entry;
506
507      while ((entry = zipInput.getNextEntry()) != null) {
508        // ignore resource fork directories and subfiles
509        if (entry.getName().toUpperCase().contains(APPLE_RESOURCE_FORK)) {
510          LOG.debug("Ignoring resource fork file: " + entry.getName());
511        }
512        // ignore directories and hidden directories (e.g. .svn) (based on flag)
513        else if (entry.isDirectory()) {
514          if (isHiddenFile(new File(entry.getName()))) {
515            LOG.debug("Ignoring hidden directory: " + entry.getName());
516          } else if (keepSubdirectories) {
517            new File(directory, entry.getName()).mkdir();
518          } else {
519            LOG.debug("Ignoring (sub)directory: " + entry.getName());
520          }
521        }
522        // ignore hidden files
523        else {
524          if (isHiddenFile(new File(entry.getName()))) {
525            LOG.debug("Ignoring hidden file: " + entry.getName());
526          } else {
527            File targetFile =
528                (keepSubdirectories)
529                    ? new File(directory, entry.getName())
530                    : new File(directory, new File(entry.getName()).getName());
531            // ensure parent folder always exists, and extract file
532            createParentFolder(targetFile);
533
534            LOG.debug("Extracting file: {} to: {}", entry.getName(), targetFile.getAbsolutePath());
535            try (OutputStream out =
536                new BufferedOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(targetFile.toPath()))) {
537              IOUtils.copy(zipInput, out);
538            }
539          }
540        }
541      }
542    }
543    // remove the wrapping root directory and flatten structure
544    if (keepSubdirectories) {
545      removeRootDirectory(directory);
546    }
547
548    File[] files = directory.listFiles();
549
550    return (files == null) ? new ArrayList<>() : Arrays.asList(files);
551  }
552
553  /**
554   * @return true if file is a hidden file or directory, or if any of its parent directories are hidden checking
555   * recursively
556   */
557  private static boolean isHiddenFile(File f) {
558    if (f.getName().startsWith(".")) {
559      return true;
560    } else if (f.getParentFile() != null) {
561      return isHiddenFile(f.getParentFile());
562    }
563    return false;
564  }
565
566  /**
567   * Removes a wrapping root directory and flatten its structure by moving all that root directory's files and
568   * subdirectories up to the same level as the root directory.
569   */
570  @SuppressWarnings("ResultOfMethodCallIgnored")
571  private static void removeRootDirectory(File directory) {
572    File[] rootFiles = directory.listFiles((FileFilter) HiddenFileFilter.VISIBLE);
573    if (rootFiles == null) {
574      LOG.error("Failed to retrieve root directory from {}", directory.getAbsolutePath());
575      return;
576    }
577
578    if (rootFiles.length != 1) {
579      LOG.error("More than one root directory at {}", directory.getAbsolutePath());
580      return;
581    }
582
583    File root = rootFiles[0];
584    if (root.isDirectory()) {
585      LOG.debug(
586          "Removing single root folder {} found in decompressed archive", root.getAbsoluteFile());
587      Collection<File> filesAndDirs =
588          FileUtils.listFilesAndDirs(root, TrueFileFilter.TRUE, TrueFileFilter.TRUE);
589      // directories shouldn't be in the end, sort
590      List<File> sortedFilesAndDirs =
591          filesAndDirs.stream()
592              .sorted(Comparator.comparing(File::getAbsolutePath))
593              .collect(Collectors.toList());
594
595      for (File f : sortedFilesAndDirs) {
596        File f2 = new File(directory, f.getName());
597        f.renameTo(f2);
598      }
599      root.delete();
600    }
601  }
602
603  /**
604   * Make parent folder.
605   *
606   * @param file destination file
607   */
608  private static void createParentFolder(File file) {
609    File parent = new File(file.getParent());
610    if (!parent.exists()) {
611      LOG.debug(
612          (parent.mkdirs())
613              ? "Created parent directory: " + parent.getAbsolutePath()
614              : "Failed to create parent directory: " + parent.getAbsolutePath());
615    }
616  }
